Specification: This module specifies Safra's distributed termination detection algorithm on a ring, following EWD 998. Nodes can be active or passive, exchange asynchronous messages tracked via per-node counters and pending-message counts, and circulate a colored token carrying position, counter summary, and color information to detect global termination. The specification includes the core system and environment actions, a safety theorem relating local termination detection to actual termination, a liveness property stating that termination is eventually detected, and additional Büchi-style auxiliary variables for loop and accepting-state tracking used to encode liveness-related reasoning.
IfThenElse: IF token.pos = N-1 THEN token.q = 0 ELSE token.q = FoldFunctionOnSet(Plus, 0, counter, {x \in Node: (token.pos+1) <= x})
FunctionOverride:
[token EXCEPT !.pos = @ - 1,
                            !.q = @ + counter[i],
                            !.color = IF color[i] = "black" THEN "black" ELSE @]
